question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: If a chord is extended outside the circle on both ends then it is called secant.
Tangent is perpendicular to the radius of the circle at the point of contact.
A line which intersects two distinct points of a circle is called tangent.
Tangent is a line touching only one point of the circle.

solution:
**Explanation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbb1048a3f07b08e680400eae2e16fdb1308b4a539ea592edb33733e17241c21.png] 

Option 1.

A secant line includes the chord and is always extended outside the circle. In other words, if the chord is extended on both sides it becomes the secant.
